title: acrorumohra hasseltii
intro: Acrorumohra hasseltii, commonly known as Java fern, is a type of aquatic plant native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acrorumohra hasseltii include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for minor cuts and burns. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
